learn.hook: A laddoo, a dice and a birthday cap. They all have shape names!
points: A sphere is round like a ball or a laddoo.
A cube is like a dice. All its faces are squares.
A cuboid is like a brick or a matchbox.
A cylinder is like a juice can or a drum.
A cone is like a birthday cap or an ice-cream cone.

example.q: Arjun sees a football, a brick and a juice can. Name their shapes.
steps: A football is round all over. It is a sphere.
A brick is like a box. It is a cuboid.
A juice can has round ends. It is a cylinder.

learn.reallife: Look in your kitchen. A gas cylinder, a sugar box and a round laddoo are all solid shapes.

games.title: Match the thing to its shape

quiz.q: A cricket ball looks like which shape?
quiz.explain: A ball is round all over, like a sphere.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up a sphere with a cylinder, which has flat ends

quiz.q: A dice is shaped like a ___.
quiz.explain: A dice has 6 faces and all of them are equal squares. That is a cube.
quiz.mistake: Thinks every box shape is a cuboid

quiz.q: Riya wears a party cap on her birthday. Its shape is a ___.
quiz.explain: A party cap has a round bottom and a pointed tip. That is a cone.
quiz.mistake: Confuses a cone with a cylinder because both have a round face

quiz.q: A brick is shaped like a ___.
quiz.explain: A brick is a long box with flat faces. That is a cuboid.
quiz.mistake: Calls a cuboid a cube even though its faces are not all equal squares

quiz.q: A can of juice is shaped like a ___.
quiz.explain: A can has a round top, a round bottom and a curved side. That is a cylinder.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up a cylinder with a cone

quiz.q: Which one is NOT shaped like a sphere?
quiz.explain: A matchbox has flat faces and corners. It is a cuboid, not a sphere.
quiz.mistake: Does not read the word NOT

teach.ask: Gappu: What shape is a ball? And what shape is a dice?
teach.praise: Yes! A ball is a sphere and a dice is a cube. You know your shapes!
teach.nudge: What is the name of the round shape like a ball? And the dice shape?

learn.hook: Push a ball and it rolls away. Push a brick and it just slides. Why?
points: A sphere is curved all over. It rolls.
A cube and a cuboid have flat faces. They slide and do not roll.
A cylinder can roll on its curved side and slide on its flat face.
Shapes with flat faces are easy to stack, one on top of another.

example.q: Kabir has a ball, a dice and a can. Which one can roll and also slide?
steps: The ball has no flat face. It rolls.
The dice has only flat faces. It slides.
The can has flat ends and a curved side. It can do both.

learn.reallife: Shopkeepers stack boxes and cans on shelves, but keep oranges in a basket so they do not roll away.

games.title: True or false?
items: A ball is curved all over, so it rolls.
A brick rolls down a slope easily.
A brick has flat faces. It slides, it does not roll.
A cylinder can roll and also slide.
It rolls on its curved side and slides on its flat face.
We can stack cubes to make a tower.
Cubes have flat faces, so they sit well on each other.
A sphere has a flat face.
A sphere is curved all over. It has no flat face.

quiz.q: Which shape rolls but has no flat face to slide on?
quiz.explain: A sphere is curved all over. It has no flat face at all.
quiz.mistake: Picks the cylinder, which does have two flat faces

quiz.q: Which shape can roll and also slide?
quiz.explain: A cylinder rolls on its curved side and slides on its flat face.
quiz.mistake: Thinks only one thing can happen for each shape

quiz.q: Meena wants to build a tall tower. Which shapes are best?
quiz.explain: Cubes have flat faces on top and bottom, so they stay on each other.
quiz.mistake: Forgets that round shapes roll off

quiz.q: Why does a cube not roll?
quiz.explain: A cube has no curved side. All its faces are flat, so it slides.
quiz.mistake: Thinks size or weight decides rolling

quiz.q: Kabir stands a can on its flat end and pushes it. What will it do?
quiz.explain: It is standing on its flat face, so it slides. It rolls only on its curved side.

quiz.q: Which one will roll down a slope?
quiz.explain: A laddoo is round like a sphere, so it rolls. The others have flat faces.
quiz.mistake: Does not notice which thing is round

teach.ask: Gappu: Why does my ball roll away but my toy brick just slides?
teach.praise: Now I see! Curved shapes roll and flat faces slide.
teach.nudge: What is different about the ball and the brick? Is it round or flat?

learn.hook: Touch a dice. Flat parts, sharp lines and pointy tips! Each has a name.
points: A face is a flat side of a shape.
An edge is the line where two faces meet.
A corner is the pointy part where edges meet.
A cube has 6 faces, 12 edges and 8 corners.
A cuboid, like a matchbox, also has 6 faces, 12 edges and 8 corners.
A sphere has no flat face, no edge and no corner.

example.q: How many faces does a dice have?

learn.reallife: Run your finger along a box. The sharp line you feel is an edge.

games.title: Match the shape to its faces
pairs: 1 round flat face and a tip

quiz.q: How many flat faces does a cube have?
quiz.explain: Top, bottom, front, back, left and right. That is 6 faces.
quiz.mistake: Counts only the faces that can be seen at one time

quiz.q: How many edges does a cube have?
quiz.explain: 4 edges on top, 4 on the bottom and 4 standing up. 4 + 4 + 4 = 12.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up edges with faces or corners

quiz.q: How many flat faces does a cylinder have?
quiz.explain: A cylinder has a flat circle on top and one at the bottom. Its side is curved.
quiz.mistake: Counts the curved side as a flat face

quiz.q: Which shape has no flat face, no edge and no corner?
quiz.explain: A sphere is curved all over. It has nothing flat or pointy.
quiz.mistake: Picks the cone, which has a flat face and a tip

quiz.q: A cone has how many flat faces?
quiz.explain: A cone has one flat circle at the bottom. The rest is curved up to the tip.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up a cone with a cylinder, which has 2 flat faces

quiz.q: Each face of a cube is shaped like a ___.
quiz.explain: All 6 faces of a cube are equal squares.
quiz.mistake: Does not look closely at the flat faces

teach.ask: Gappu: What is a face? What is an edge? I am confused!
teach.praise: Hooray! A face is flat, an edge is where faces meet, and a corner is pointy.
teach.nudge: Can you tell me about the corners too? Where do the edges meet?
